name: def_lowvol_universe
note: Defensive as a risk CONSTRAINT rather than a ranking: hard-cap the universe at 0.30 annualised vol (the calm ~37% of names, ~106 per scan, ~76 after the 200DMA filter) and rank on trend within it. This is how low-vol is implemented in practice and is the alternative hypothesis to 01-05 - that defensive pays as a filter on trend, not as a stock-picking signal.
